notes.title: Patch: Better support for Oculus and Windows MR
notes.notes:
Oculus
The Steam version of the game has support for both using SteamVR and the Oculus SDK, it does however automatically choose to use SteamVR if it finds it available. 

If you wish to use the Oculus SDK we generally recommend buying the game on the Oculus Store instead, but if you already own it on Steam you can now start the game with the launch option 
"-vrmode oculus" (without the brackets).

Windows MR
We don't officially have support for Windows MR, but people have told us it worked just fine in the old version, but was broken in this one. This update should hopefully fix that!

Bug fixes

    Fixed bug where two of the recipes were swapped on the Winter levels.

    Added a 'Reset Kitchen' button. 
While in the main menu, press the menu button on your controller to bring up the mini-menu. There is now an option to reset the scale, center and rotation of the kitchen area.

notes.title: Patch 1.08 - Better 'Easy mode' & better Oculus support
notes.notes:
Changes:

    Difficulty option added to the settings menu, allow the player to switch to 'Easy mode'. In 'Easy mode' ingredients will not get moldy and every customer will have 3 times more patience.
    VR Controller option added to the settings menu. This will allow people to change to Oculus mode which positions the hands better for the Touch controllers and changes the grab button to the inner trigger.

notes.title: Hotfix: Winter Update
notes.notes:
Severall people have reported a bug with the "Next Level"-button since the winter update. We've now solved this issue.

This small update includes:

     Fixed "Next Level" & "Too easy?" buttons
     An option for lower quality graphics. (This may help some users that are experiencing performance issues.)


Thanks for your patience, I hope this update will allow you to enjoy the game and the new update without any issues!

notes.title: Winter Update!
notes.notes:
It's time for the holidays and the robots are hungry for their holiday-burgers!

This is a free update that includes:

     10 new winter themed levels
     3 new songs
     5 new recipes
     A holiday decorated restaurant
     Option to enable 'Left handed' mode
     Recepies in front of the player


We hope you will enjoy this new content and that you all have a great holiday!

notes.title: Patch 1.05
notes.notes:
Changes:

    Time before ketchup & mustard bottles teleport to their original positions has been increased.


New:

    The mouse is now locked to the window while playing multiplayer.
  Added an option for turning of controllers in the settings menu. Some players had an issue with the camera continuously spinning, turning controllers off should fix this issue and allow the game to be played with the keyboard and mouse. We're working on a better solution for this issue.

notes.title: Patch 1.04
notes.notes:
New:


    Added a "Too easy" button that appears after beating a level. This allows players to more easily skip to a more difficult level.


Each fifth level has always been unlocked from the start of the game but many players fail to notice this as they play the game the first time. This update will hopefully make it so that players can more easily play at an appropriate difficulty.

notes.title: Controller changes
notes.notes:
We are improving the controlls to make the ketchup/mustard easier.

Before we only had the grip buttons, which were hard to find even for experienced players. Later on we added the thumb button, one could choose which one they perfered: grip button or thumb pad.

However, older people and/or kids seem to hold the grip buttons pressed constantly while playing. As a result the thumb button wouldn't work since pressing both the grip and thumb buttons didn't work for some reason.

We will now add more and easier controllers for this problem, starting with adding more commands in which the controller responds to, as well as implementing a Vive controller guide when a player holds the ketchup/mustard to long without getting anything out of the bottle.

This will hopefuly help the inexperienced players even more.
